english.title: Fail to furnish information relating to exported goods evidenced under EU law
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[an exporter of goods from the United Kingdom, the origin of which was evidenced]_
(B)_[a person appearing to the Commissioners or an officer to have been concerned with the exportation of goods from the United Kingdom, the origin of which was evidenced]_
(C)_[a person appearing to the Commissioners or an officer to have been concerned with the exportation from the United Kingdom of goods from which goods had been produced, the origin of which was evidenced]_
(D)_[a person appearing to the Commissioners or an officer to have been concerned with the exportation from the United Kingdom of goods from which goods had been manufactured, the origin of which was evidenced]_
(E)_[a person appearing to the Commissioners or an officer to have been concerned with the obtaining of a certificate of evidence furnished]_
(F)_[a person appearing to the Commissioners or an officer to have been concerned with the furnishing of a certificate of evidence]_

in accordance with section 80 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979, on being required by the Commissioners or an officer to do so, without reasonable cause, failed to

(G)_[furnish information in the form required and within the time specified by the Commissioners or the officer]_
(H)_[produce for inspection and allow the taking of copies of, or extracts from, an invoice relating to goods]_
(I)_[produce for inspection and allow the taking of copies of, or extracts from, a bill of lading relating to goods]_
(J)_[produce for inspection and allow the taking of copies of, or extracts from, a book relating to goods]_
(K)_[produce for inspection and allow the taking of copies of, or extracts from, a document relating to goods]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 80 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a chithau yn

(A)_[allforiwr nwyddau o'r Deyrnas Unedig, a'u tarddiad wedi'i dystio]_
(B)_[unigolyn sy'n ymddangos i'r Comisiynwyr neu swyddog i fod â rhan mewn allforio nwyddau o'r Deyrnas Unedig, a'u tarddiad wedi'i dystio]_
(C)_[unigolyn sy'n ymddangos i'r Comisiynwyr neu swyddog i fod â rhan mewn allforio nwyddau o'r Deyrnas Unedig sef nwyddau y gwnaethpwyd nwyddau ohonynt, a'u tarddiad wedi'i dystio]_

(F)_[unigolyn sy'n ymddangos i'r Comisiynwyr neu swyddog i fod â rhan mewn rhoi tystysgrif o dystiolaeth]_
